opening.argument: The presentation frames OneCoin as a business opportunity by seeking “partners who want to join us in this venture in this incredible business” and directing viewers to click a link and create an account for access to the back office. It then connects participation to prospective financial gain, stating that “with a high demand the expected value of a single one coin will over the next couple of years increase and we can expect a very decent capital gain.” The paid mechanism is concrete: mining-pool participation starts “as low as €130,” while submitted tokens are described as generating coins in a personal account. A separate graphic displays euro-priced tiers, token quantities and splits, tying recruitment and projected gains to paid participation and token flow. Although the scenario is expressly not guaranteed, payment outcomes and projected values remain unverified.
